title: First two squares of the canonical direct-image Mayer--Vietoris comparison
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, let $Y=U\cup V$ be a two-open cover and $X=h^{-1}U\cup h^{-1}V$ its inverse-image cover. Assume the derived categories of modules on $X,Y$ and all their opens exist. For every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ use the explicit triangle and normalized comparison data of [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Write $A=Rh_*\operatorname{MV}_X(E)$ and $B=\operatorname{MV}_Y(Rh_*E)$, and write $c_2,c_3$ for the middle and intersection comparison. Then $A_1c_2=B_1$ and $A_2c_3=c_2B_2$: the first two triangle squares commute.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); official Stacks pages read online

proof.text: Apply single-open unit compatibility at U and V. Expand the first triangle arrow and the middle comparison. Mathlib biprod.map_lift_mapBiprod converts the direct image of the lift into the lift of direct images. Postcompose with the two open comparisons and apply biprod.hom_ext, using map_fst/map_snd and lift_fst/lift_snd to recover the two unit equations.

Apply the proved nested-open compatibility at W=U intersect V, once for W contained in U and once for W contained in V. Expand the second arrow and the middle comparison. Rewrite direct image of biprod.desc using biprod.mapBiprod_hom_desc, cancel the common biproduct comparison by congrArg, and apply biprod.hom_ext'. The inl equation is the first restriction compatibility; the inr equation is its V counterpart after applying Neg.neg, using Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp and Preadditive.comp_neg. Inverse image of an intersection is definitionally the intersection of inverse images.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); official Stacks pages read online
proof_origin.note: Biproduct assembly formally proved from single-open unit compatibility. Nested restriction compatibility is also formally proved by adjunction cancellation, so only one lower hole remains.

lean.statement: theorem schemeMV_directImage_squares (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Y.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) (hcover' : (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊔ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) = ⊤) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) : (schemeMVImageTriangle h (schemeMVTriangle X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) hcover' E)).mor₁ ≫ (schemeMVMiddleComparison h U V E).hom = (schemeMVTriangle Y U V hcover ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)).mor₁ ∧ (schemeMVImageTriangle h (schemeMVTriangle X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) hcover' E)).mor₂ ≫ (schemeMVOpenComparison h (U ⊓ V) E).hom = (schemeMVMiddleComparison h U V E).hom ≫ (schemeMVTriangle Y U V hcover ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)).mor₂
